rooms.title: Room
rooms.description: A private chat room identified by its unique room code and secured by password verification.

roomId.description: Unique code identifier for the room.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the room password.

participantCount.description: Number of currently active participants in the room (0 to 2).

participants.description: Map of active participant presence records keyed by participant ID, containing joinedAt, lastSeen, typing, typingTimestamp, and lastReadTimestamp.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the room record was created.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp when the room was last active.

messages.title: Message
messages.description: Chat messages and file attachments sent within a room.

enc.description: Indicates whether the payload is encrypted with the client AES-GCM-256 enclave.

ct.description: Base64 encoded AES-GCM ciphertext with authentication tag

file.description: Optional file metadata and small payload

fileChunks.title: File Chunk
fileChunks.description: Chunked pieces of compressed large files stored in rooms/{roomId}/files/{fileId}/chunks/{chunkId}

callSessions.title: Call Session
callSessions.description: Peer-to-peer WebRTC signaling state for 1-to-1 video/audio calls stored in rooms/{roomId}/calls/{callId}

callCandidates.title: Call ICE Candidate
callCandidates.description: ICE candidate payloads exchanged between peers for WebRTC connectivity

groupRequests.title: Group Room Feature Request
groupRequests.description: User requests and votes for multi-peer (> 2 people) group rooms with custom team sizes and use cases.

requestedSize.description: Target number of people in room (3 to 50+)

useCase.description: Why the user wants group chat (e.g. family, private team, confidential study group)

contact.description: Optional email or pseudonym for notification

securityPriority.description: Main security preference (e.g. Zero Logs, Full E2EE Mesh, Ephemeral Auto-burn)

scratchpads.title: Collaborative Scratchpad and Whiteboard Canvas
scratchpads.description: Real-time collaborative markdown notes and multi-user drawing canvas data stored in rooms/{roomId}/scratchpad/{docId}

content.description: Encrypted or formatted markdown notes text

strokes.description: Serialized drawing strokes array for interactive whiteboard

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Stores room metadata, passwordHash, and participant count.

/rooms/{roomId}/files/{fileId}/chunks/{c.description: File chunk subcollection for compressed files.
